messages:
Ana Gomez: throwing an alternative out there for postmortem follow-ups: a lightweight escalation ladder + automated micro-check reminders. aim: reduce "stale" actions without adding weekly meetings. thoughts?
Tom Rivers: sounds promising. what's a micro-check?
Ana Gomez: 1-line status update from owner every 7 days for items >7d. Auto-ping if missed. If an item is >14d and still open, escalate to verifier; >30d escalate to sponsor.
Priya Shah: love the tiers. can we make the escalation cadence configurable per severity? some "low-risk" things can be 21d before sponsor ping.
Ana Gomez: yes configurable. default matrix I sketched: 
```
- 0d: acknowledge (owner)
- 7d: owner micro-check (auto-email/ping)
- 14d: verifier escalation (cc owner + verifier)
- 21d: sponsor escalation (adds product/manager)
- 30d+: exec alert (only for P0/P1 with recurrence tag)
```
Tom Rivers: how do we avoid noise? I don't want OpsWatcher spamming folks.
Ana Gomez: OpsWatcher will batch reminders once per day and include a short summary: owner, status, blocking reason, next step. it won't DM every missing item separately.
incident-bot: Note: `/incident-track escalate <issue>` will trigger the ladder rules and post to #incidents.
Priya Shah: implementation idea: store `escalation_state` and `next_touch` on the tracker. then dashboard columns: New / Waiting for micro-check / Verifier review / Sponsor / Blocked / Closed.
Tom Rivers: can we auto-fill the initial owner from the PM metadata so someone doesn't forget to assign?
Ana Gomez: yep — when creating tracker from PM, require `owner` and `verifier` fields. ops-bot enforces creation if missing.
Priya Shah: snippet for the Jira filter I want to use: 
```
project = INCIDENTS AND labels in (postmortem) AND status not in (Closed) ORDER BY next_touch ASC
```
Ana Gomez: plan for recurrence detection: if the same service appears in 3 postmortems in 90 days, mark actions with `recurrence:service` and bump priority for the ladder (shorter windows).
Tom Rivers: nice. what metrics do we measure during pilot? closure time, #escalations, % missed micro-checks?
Priya Shah: also track blocked_reason tags and whether verifier resolved within 7 days of escalation.
OpsWatcher: Health check scheduled: daily summary at 08:00 for #incidents (includes items due for micro-check and >14d escalations).
Ana Gomez: pilot proposal: 6-week run, opt-in for teams. I'll onboard two teams (payments, search) to iterate.
Tom Rivers: onboarding notes: need a 1-pager + a short recorded demo showing how to add owner/verifier and how escalations look.
Priya Shah: I'll draft the 1-pager and demo. estimated 3 workdays.
Ana Gomez: responsibilities: Priya = docs + demo (3d), Tom = OpsWatcher batching config and Jira filter (2d), Ana = pilot coordination + metric dashboard (ongoing).
Tom Rivers: OK I'll also add a small `next_touch` column on the dashboard so the micro-check list is obvious in ops runbook.
incident-bot: Reminder: create the tracker with `/incident-track create --template micro-checks` to prefill fields.
Ana Gomez: decision: run the 6-week pilot with escalation ladder + daily batched micro-check reminders, recurrence auto-prioritization, and the dashboard filters. review after 6 weeks for closure velocity and noise.
Priya Shah: small caveat: teams can opt for longer windows if they tag items as "low-risk". we'll enforce that with a required justification field.
Tom Rivers: ack. I'll start config changes today and post the filter link when live.
Ana Gomez: thanks all. if you see issues during pilot prefix thread replies with `pilot-signal:` so we can triage quickly. :raised_hands:
